scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The rank enumerator applies only to ordinary Leibniz derivations D with D composed with D equal to zero on total-degree-three truncated commutative polynomial algebras with at least two generators. It is not a graded signed derivation result. Finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite-field proof. Novelty has residual risk from historical equivalent terminology and inaccessible complete literature. No independent verification has been performed.
title: Square-zero derivation rank spectra of quadratic-jet algebras
